emails.subject: Thanks for helping at the January dock cleanup
emails.body: Thanks for helping with the January 3 winter dock cleanup. The volunteer lead marked the morning bench-wipe and towel-sort work complete, and there are no follow-up assignments from that shift.

emails.subject: Saturday coffee receipt split settled
emails.body: Thanks for grabbing the post-erg coffees on January 10. I handed you cash at the dock, so we are square on my share.
